title: Hospital Department Staffing Load
scenario: In a hospital, calculate the running total of patient admissions per department, but reset the count every time the department reaches a threshold of 100 total admissions.
tableSchema: admissions (adm_id INT, dept_id INT, adm_date DATE, patient_count INT)
hint: Use a recursive sum logic or group segments by integer division of cumulative sums.
correctQuery: SELECT dept_id, adm_date, patient_count, SUM(patient_count) OVER(PARTITION BY dept_id, grp ORDER BY adm_date) AS running_total FROM (SELECT *, SUM(patient_count) OVER(PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY adm_date) / 100 AS grp FROM admissions) t;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE admissions (adm_id INT, dept_id INT, adm_date DATE, patient_count INT);
